text:
maria: deploybot triggered an emergency hotfix candidate v2.3.8 for kv-cache leak. planning EU roll during 02:00-03:00 UTC change window. requesting expedited approval to skip canary due to active customer errors. details: https://confluence/release/v2.3.8 (root)
deploybot: Deploybot: preflight checks passed. staged tests green. Canary-skip requested by @maria requires 2 approvers with release:approve.
sam: +1 from me if ops confirms capacity. i'm oncall and can monitor. :thumbsup:
eva: what's the rollback plan if errors spike? don't want cascading failures across embeddings.
maria: rollback plan: immediate image pin to last-good sha abc123, route cut via rr-turndown, no DB migrations in this hotfix. auto-rollback if 5m error rate > 2%. commands below.
maria: ```sh
# rollback
kubectl set image deploy/llm-service llm=image:abc123 -n prod-eu
deploybot rollback --thread 6219876543 --reason \"auto-rollback\"
```
ops-oncall: checked capacity in eu-west1, spare nodes available. i'll be in the loop during rollout. +1.
sam: if we're skipping canary, we need a one-line release note for CS and ops. @maria can you add?
maria: added to release notes: "v2.3.8 — fix kv-cache leak causing embed misses; emergency hotfix; rolling EU during 02:00-03:00 UTC." link: https://docs/releases/v2.3.8-notes
deploybot: Deploybot: Approval count now 3 (maria, sam, ops-oncall). Initiating rollout in 5m. Canary-skip override provided by approvers. streaming logs: https://deploylogs/6219876543
maria: monitoring playbook loaded, dashboards pinned. @eva please watch latency and error graphs closely 0-15m post-deploy.
eva: standing by. watching p50/p99, error-rate, kv-miss. will call rollback on first sign of regression.
deploybot: Deploybot: Phase 1 (20% traffic) -> OK. Phase 2 (60% traffic) -> OK. Phase 3 (100%) -> Completed. No elevated error rates observed.
sam: nice. ops-oncall: can you run a quick sanity curl? `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -X POST https://api.eu1.redwood/sanity -d '{}'` should be 200.
ops-oncall: ran the probe, got 200. kv-miss rate down ~95% compared to pre-patch baseline.
maria: great, closing rollout. tagging support and product for release note publish. :tada:
thread_summary: Hotfix v2.3.8 kv-cache leak: expedited approvals obtained (maria, sam, ops-oncall). Canary skipped per approvers. Rollout phased to EU, auto-rollback plan defined (pin to abc123), ops validated success; release notes updated.
